done_when: A review no longer finds: Not done: forge next omits ready fixes without a worktree
why: Review finding left open by FORGE-BOARD-2/COUNTS: Not done: forge next omits ready fixes without a worktree (src/forge/nextstep.py:725): Raise: Functional. The new no-worktree advice handles a ready fix when `_item` is called, but `forge next` reaches fixes only by iterating local worktrees (`nextstep.py:206–217`). On a second clone with the fix's fetched branch and shared clean record but no fix worktree, `forge board --json` shows it ready while `forge next` never names it or its starter.
